senses.gloss: f. (denom. of כִּנָּם; cmp. כַּלְמְתָא) vermin, moth.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 9:3:2">Y. B. Kam. IX, beg. 6ᵈ</cite> <he>הרקיבו מן הכ׳</he> if the grain became ruined by moths, contrad. to <he>תולעים</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:1">Makhsh. VI, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 3:1">Tosef. ib. III, 1</cite> <he>מפני הכ׳</he> in order to prevent the grain from getting mothy.—Pl. <he>כְּנִימּוֹת</he>.
